card.title: Nintendo Switch Video Output Issues: No Video or HDMI Output

source.title: Nintendo Switch Video Output Issues: No Video or HDMI Output

claims.statement: A Switch that charges but gives no dock video is most often blown chokes near PI3USB or a faulty PI3USB30532; the chokes should have continuity in parallel but not across.
Also check caps around M92T36 for shorts and compare USB-C port readings with a T-824.

procedure: Replace chokes or PI3USB30532; test resolutions.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
